scenarios.title: Cost anomaly detection
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Continuously monitors spending patterns to detect unusual spikes or drops that may indicate misconfigurations, runaway resources, or billing errors.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Analyze the cost data for the last 7 days across all subscriptions. Identify any resource or service where daily cost deviates more than 20% from the 30-day rolling average. Provide the resource ID, cost delta, and likely root cause."

scenarios.title: 6-month cost summary & trends
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Provides medium-term cost trend visibility, helping teams understand seasonal patterns and growth trajectory.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Show me a 6-month cost trend summary for subscription '{subscription_name}'. Break down by month, show total and per-service spend, and identify the top 3 services driving growth."

scenarios.title: Top consumer services identification
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Identifies which Azure services drive the most cost, enabling targeted optimization efforts on highest-impact areas.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List the top 10 Azure services by cost in the last 30 days across all subscriptions. For each, show current month cost, previous month cost, percentage change, and number of instances."

scenarios.title: Cost analysis by tag/environment
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Breaks down Azure spending grouped by environment tags (dev, staging, prod), identifies which environments consume disproportionate budget, and tracks the cost ratio between environments over time.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Show me the cost breakdown for the last month grouped by the 'Environment' tag across all subscriptions. Show the ratio of each environment's cost to production. Highlight any environment where spend exceeds the previous month by more than 15% or where dev/test exceeds 30% of production cost."

scenarios.title: Cross-period cost comparison (MG level)
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Compares cost across billing periods at Management Group level for executive budget reviews.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Compare total cost for management group 'Enterprise' between the current month and the same month last year. Break down by subscription, show absolute and percentage change, and highlight any subscription with >25% increase."

scenarios.title: Consolidated cost reporting
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Produces executive-ready cost reports summarizing spend across management groups, subscriptions, and services for leadership reviews.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Generate a consolidated monthly cost report for all subscriptions under management group 'Production'. Include total spend, month-over-month change, top 10 services by cost, and top 5 fastest-growing resources. Format as a summary suitable for leadership."

scenarios.title: Resources with highest cost increase
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Identifies individual resources with the sharpest cost growth, catching runaway spending early.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Identify the top 20 resources with the highest absolute cost increase week-over-week across all subscriptions. For each, show resource name, type, previous week cost, current week cost, delta, and percentage increase."

scenarios.title: Underutilized resources detection
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Finds resources consuming budget but delivering minimal value based on utilization metrics.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Scan all VMs, App Services, SQL Databases, and Redis Caches across subscriptions. Flag resources where average CPU < 5%, average connections < 10, or average requests < 100/hour over the last 7 days. Show monthly cost of each underutilized resource."

scenarios.title: Disk tier-down opportunities
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Identifies managed disks provisioned at a higher tier than their actual IOPS/throughput demands.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all Premium SSD and Ultra Disk managed disks. Compare their actual P95 IOPS and throughput over the last 14 days against provisioned tier limits. Recommend tier-down to Standard SSD where actual usage is below Standard SSD limits. Show savings estimate."

scenarios.title: Orphaned resources & cost impact analysis
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Finds all types of orphaned resources — unattached disks, unused public IPs, orphaned NICs, empty NSGs, idle Load Balancers, zombie snapshots, unused App Gateways/Front Door backends, and empty App Service Plans — in a single consolidated scan.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Query all subscriptions for orphaned resources: (1) managed disks not attached to any VM, (2) public IPs not associated with any resource, (3) NICs not attached to a VM, (4) NSGs not associated with any subnet or NIC, (5) Load Balancers with 0 healthy backend instances or 0 bytes processed in 7 days, (6) disk snapshots older than 90 days whose source disk no longer exists, (7) App Gateway/Front Door backend pools with 0 requests in 14 days, (8) App Service Plans hosting 0 apps or only stopped apps. For each, show resource name, type, RG, age, and monthly cost. Summarize total waste."

scenarios.title: Log Analytics workspace ingestion cost analysis
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Analyzes which data tables and solutions drive the highest log ingestion volume and cost.
scenarios.source_prompt: "For each Log Analytics workspace, show ingestion volume by table for the last 30 days. Identify top 5 tables by GB ingested. Show daily trend, cost per table, and recommend tables that could be moved to Basic tier or have shorter retention."

scenarios.title: Budget alerts configuration audit
scenarios.upstream_category: AZURE BILLING AND ACTIVE DIRECTORY TENANT
scenarios.source_description: Ensures every subscription and critical resource group has properly configured budget alerts to prevent surprise overruns.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check all subscriptions and resource groups tagged 'CostCenter'. Identify those without a budget configured or where budget alerts are set above 100% only. Recommend budget amounts based on 3-month average spend + 20% buffer."

scenarios.title: RBAC redundancy & over-privilege assessment
scenarios.source_description: Analyzes all role assignments across scopes to detect redundancies (e.g., same identity assigned Contributor at both subscription and child resource group level) and over-privileged assignments where a narrower role would suffice. Helps reduce attack surface and simplify access governance.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Analyze all RBAC role assignments across subscriptions. Identify: (1) redundant assignments — same principal with the same or higher role at a parent scope making child-scope assignments unnecessary, (2) principals with Owner or Contributor that could operate with a narrower built-in role based on their Activity Log operations in the last 30 days, (3) multiple role assignments to the same principal at the same scope that could be consolidated. For each finding, show principal name, type, assigned roles, scopes, and recommended action."

scenarios.title: RBAC access audit (who has what)
scenarios.source_description: Provides comprehensive visibility into access grants, highlighting over-privileged accounts and stale assignments.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all role assignments across subscription '{subscription_name}'. For each, show: principal name, principal type (user/group/SP), role, scope, assignment source (direct/inherited). Flag: (1) Owner/Contributor at subscription scope, (2) assignments to individual users (should be groups), (3) assignments where principal no longer exists in Entra ID."

scenarios.title: Permissions required for an action
scenarios.source_description: Determines the minimum RBAC permissions required to perform a specific Azure operation, supporting least-privilege design.
scenarios.source_prompt: "What is the minimum RBAC role or specific permissions needed to perform: '{operation_description}'? Show: (1) required resource provider operations (e.g., Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start/action), (2) matching built-in role(s), (3) if no exact match, a custom role definition JSON with minimum permissions."

scenarios.title: Stale RBAC assignments
scenarios.source_description: Finds role assignments granted to principals that no longer exist or haven't signed in, reducing attack surface.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all role assignments where: (1) the principal object no longer exists in Entra ID (orphaned SIDs), (2) the user principal hasn't signed in for > 90 days, (3) the service principal has no recent activity. Show assignment scope, role, principal display name/ID, and last sign-in date. Recommend removal."

scenarios.title: High-privilege operation tracking
scenarios.source_description: Monitors sensitive operations (role assignments, policy changes, key vault access) that could indicate security issues or excessive privilege use.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Query Activity Log for the last 24 hours. Filter for high-privilege operations: role assignment create/delete, policy assignment create/delete, key vault secret access, subscription-level deployments, management group changes. Show caller, operation, target, and timestamp."

scenarios.title: Resources created yesterday
scenarios.source_description: Detects new resources provisioned in the last 24 hours, catching shadow IT and unauthorized deployments early.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all resources created in the last 24 hours across all subscriptions. Show: resource name, type, resource group, subscription, who created it (from Activity Log), and whether it was created via ARM template/pipeline or manual portal action. Flag resources not matching naming conventions."

scenarios.title: Resource age tracking
scenarios.source_description: Identifies long-running resources that may be forgotten, orphaned, or candidates for modernization.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Find all resources older than {X} months (default 12) that have had no write operations in their Activity Log in the last 90 days. Show resource name, type, creation date, last activity date, and monthly cost. Flag as potential candidates for decommission review."

scenarios.title: AI model inventory & retirement lifecycle
scenarios.source_description: Inventories all deployed Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry model deployments across subscriptions, cross-references each model and version against the official Microsoft model retirement schedule, and flags deployments that are already deprecated, approaching retirement, or running on a version with a known successor. Helps teams plan model migrations proactively and avoid service disruptions when deprecated models stop accepting requests.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry model deployments across all subscriptions. For each, show: resource name, resource group, model name, model version, deployment name, and deployment date. Cross-reference each model and version against the official retirement schedule at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry-classic/openai/concepts/model-retirement-schedule. Classify each deployment as: (1) 'Retired' — model version past its retirement date, (2) 'Retiring soon' — retirement date within the next 90 days, (3) 'Current' — no retirement date announced or retirement date > 90 days away. For retired and retiring-soon models, show the retirement date, recommended replacement model/version, and the number of days until retirement. Summarize total deployments by status."

scenarios.title: Extension health across VMs
scenarios.source_description: Monitors VM extension status to catch failed deployments or stuck provisioning that blocks updates and monitoring.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check all VM extensions across subscriptions. Identify: (1) extensions in 'Failed' provisioning state, (2) extensions in 'Transitioning' state for > 1 hour, (3) extensions with handler status errors, (4) VMs with conflicting extensions. Show VM name, extension, status, and error message."

scenarios.title: Resource group sprawl detection
scenarios.source_description: Identifies resource group proliferation that increases management overhead and indicates organizational disorder.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Analyze all resource groups across subscriptions. Flag: (1) empty RGs with 0 resources, (2) RGs with only 1 resource (consolidation candidate), (3) RGs with names suggesting temporary/test purpose in production, (4) RGs without required tags. Show RG name, resource count, total cost, and creation date."

scenarios.title: Resource lock compliance audit
scenarios.source_description: Ensures production resources have appropriate delete locks to prevent accidental deletion.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check all resources in subscriptions tagged 'Environment=Production'. Identify resources of type VM, SQL Server, Storage Account, Key Vault, and AKS that do NOT have a CanNotDelete or ReadOnly lock. Show resource name, type, RG, and recommend lock type."

scenarios.title: Subscription hygiene score
scenarios.source_description: Computes a composite health score per subscription measuring operational maturity across multiple dimensions.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Calculate a hygiene score (0-100) for each subscription based on: (1) tag compliance (20%), (2) resource lock coverage (15%), (3) alert rule coverage (20%), (4) diagnostic settings coverage (15%), (5) policy compliance (15%), (6) Defender for Cloud score (15%). Show score breakdown and improvement recommendations for subscriptions scoring < 70."

scenarios.title: Subscription limits approaching
scenarios.source_description: Monitors Azure subscription-level limits (resource counts, quotas) to prevent deployment failures from hitting limits.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check all subscriptions for resource quota usage. Show: (1) vCPU usage vs limit per family per region, (2) public IP count vs limit, (3) VNet count vs limit, (4) storage account count vs limit. Alert on any quota at > 80% utilization."

scenarios.title: Management Group hierarchy audit
scenarios.source_description: Validates the MG hierarchy structure, finding misplaced subscriptions or empty management groups.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Show the full Management Group hierarchy tree. For each MG, show: child subscription count, policies assigned, and RBAC roles. Flag: (1) empty MGs with no children, (2) subscriptions directly under root MG, (3) MGs with conflicting policies compared to parent."

scenarios.title: Move resources between subscriptions
scenarios.source_description: Validates and plans resource moves between subscriptions, checking for blockers and dependencies.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Evaluate moving resources from resource group '{source_rg}' to subscription '{target_subscription}'. Run validation: (1) check resource types that support move, (2) identify resources that cannot be moved (locks, dependencies), (3) check quota in target subscription, (4) identify impacted RBAC and policies. Generate the move command with --validate-only first."

scenarios.title: Private endpoint & public exposure audit
scenarios.source_description: Identifies PaaS resources still accessible over public internet that should use Private Endpoints, and inventories all publicly accessible resources for attack surface awareness.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all Storage Accounts, SQL Servers, Key Vaults, Cosmos DB, App Services, and other PaaS resources across subscriptions. For each, check: (1) is public network access enabled? (2) are there private endpoints configured? (3) what is the public FQDN/IP? Flag resources with public access enabled but no private endpoint. Show resource, public endpoint, and recommendation."

scenarios.title: Public IP inventory & justification
scenarios.source_description: Inventories all public IP addresses, identifies orphaned ones, and validates that each attached PIP is justified.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all Public IP addresses across subscriptions. For each, show: resource name, IP address, SKU, associated resource (or 'unattached'), allocation method, and creation date. Flag PIPs that are: unattached, attached to stopped VMs, or attached to non-production resources."

scenarios.title: Network topology diagram
scenarios.source_description: Auto-generates a visual network topology showing VNets, peerings, subnets, gateways, and connected resources.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Generate a Mermaid diagram showing the network topology for subscription '{subscription_name}'. Include all VNets, their subnets, peering connections, VPN/ExpressRoute gateways, private endpoints, and key resources in each subnet. Show address spaces and peering status."

scenarios.title: Azure Firewall rule generation
scenarios.source_description: Generates properly structured Azure Firewall rules based on requirements, following naming conventions and best practices.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Generate an Azure Firewall network rule to allow traffic from subnet '{source_subnet}' to '{destination}' on ports {ports}. Follow naming convention '{prefix}-{direction}-{service}'. Include the az CLI command and Bicep snippet to deploy it."

scenarios.title: Firewall log analysis (KQL)
scenarios.source_description: Analyzes Azure Firewall logs to identify blocked traffic patterns, top talkers, and potential misconfigurations.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Query Azure Firewall diagnostic logs for the last 24 hours. Show: (1) top 20 denied flows by count, (2) denied flows where source is an internal subnet (potential misconfiguration), (3) allowed flows to suspicious destinations, (4) traffic volume by rule collection."

scenarios.title: DNS/VPN troubleshooting
scenarios.source_description: Investigates DNS resolution failures and VPN connectivity issues to restore hybrid and name resolution services.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Diagnose DNS and VPN issues: (1) check DNS resolution failures — which queries are returning NXDOMAIN or SERVFAIL, from which clients, for which domains, (2) check VPN tunnel status — which tunnels are down, disconnect reason, BGP peer state, and last successful connection time. Provide remediation steps."

scenarios.title: Overly permissive NSG rules audit
scenarios.source_description: Identifies network security rules that are too broad, exposing resources to unnecessary risk.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Scan all NSGs across subscriptions. Flag rules where: (1) source = 'Any' or '0.0.0.0/0' on non-load-balancer ports, (2) destination port = '*' (any), (3) priority allows wide port ranges (>100 ports). Show NSG name, rule name, direction, access, source, destination, and port range. Recommend tighter scoping."

scenarios.title: VNet peering health check
scenarios.source_description: Monitors VNet peering connections for status issues, disconnected peerings, or asymmetric configurations.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all VNet peerings across subscriptions. Check: (1) peering status (Connected/Disconnected/Initiated), (2) both sides exist and are connected, (3) gateway transit settings are symmetric, (4) address space overlaps. Flag any peering not in 'Connected' state or with misconfigured transit."

scenarios.title: ExpressRoute / VPN Gateway health
scenarios.source_description: Monitors hybrid connectivity gateway health, tunnel status, and throughput to prevent outages.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check all ExpressRoute circuits and VPN Gateways. Show: (1) circuit/gateway provisioning state, (2) peering state (for ER), (3) tunnel connection status (for VPN), (4) BGP peer state, (5) ingress/egress throughput last 1h vs capacity. Alert on any tunnel down or BGP not established."

scenarios.title: SSL/TLS certificate expiration tracking
scenarios.source_description: Tracks certificates across Azure services to prevent outages caused by expired certificates.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Scan all certificates in: Key Vaults, App Service certificates, Application Gateway SSL certs, Front Door custom domains, and API Management. Show certificate subject, issuer, expiration date, and days remaining. Alert on any certificate expiring within 30 days."

scenarios.title: DDoS protection coverage audit
scenarios.source_description: Identifies VNets hosting public-facing workloads without DDoS Protection Standard enabled.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all VNets containing subnets with public IP addresses or Application Gateways. Check whether DDoS Protection Standard is enabled on each VNet. Flag VNets with public-facing resources but no DDoS protection. Show VNet name, public resource count, and estimated DDoS plan cost."

scenarios.title: DNS zone record hygiene
scenarios.source_description: Identifies dangling DNS records pointing to deleted Azure resources, which could be hijacked by attackers.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Query all Azure DNS zones and Private DNS zones. For each A, AAAA, and CNAME record, verify the target resource still exists in the subscription. Flag records where: (1) target IP is not assigned to any resource, (2) CNAME target domain is not resolving, (3) alias records referencing deleted resources."

scenarios.title: Defender for Cloud assessment
scenarios.source_description: Provides a security posture snapshot from Defender for Cloud, highlighting critical findings and score trends.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Pull Defender for Cloud assessment for all subscriptions: (1) secure score current and 30-day trend, (2) unhealthy resources by severity (high/medium/low), (3) top 10 recommendations by impacted resource count, (4) new recommendations in last 7 days. Prioritize by exploitability and blast radius."

scenarios.title: Certificate renewal automation
scenarios.source_description: Monitors certificate expiration in Key Vault and triggers renewal workflows before expiry causes outages.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check all certificates in Key Vault accounts across subscriptions. For each: show subject, issuer, expiration date, auto-renewal status, and days remaining. For certificates expiring in < 30 days without auto-renewal: trigger renewal workflow or alert the certificate owner. Show certificates that failed auto-renewal attempts."

scenarios.title: Service Health incidents & resource impact
scenarios.source_description: Detects Azure platform incidents and maps them to specific customer resources to quantify blast radius during outages.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check Azure Service Health for any active incidents affecting resources in my subscriptions. Show incident title, affected services, impacted regions, status, and list my specific resources in those regions. For each impacted resource, show current health status and dependent workloads affected. Suggest mitigation actions if available."

scenarios.title: Planned maintenance awareness
scenarios.source_description: Proactively surfaces upcoming Azure maintenance events to plan workload failovers.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all planned maintenance events from Azure Service Health for the next 7 days affecting my subscriptions. Show event name, affected service, scheduled window, impacted region, and my resources in that region."

scenarios.title: Executive operational report generation (PDF)
scenarios.source_description: Generates a comprehensive, executive-ready operational report consolidating key metrics across cost, security, compliance, and availability into a single formatted document (PDF or HTML). Combines data from multiple sources — Cost Management, Defender for Cloud, Resource Health, alert history, and policy compliance — into a structured narrative with charts, tables, and recommendations that can be shared with leadership without further editing.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Generate a monthly executive operational report for management group 'Production' covering the last 30 days. Include sections for: (1) Cost summary — total spend, MoM change, top 5 cost drivers, anomalies detected, (2) Security posture — Defender secure score trend, new high-severity findings, (3) Availability — resource health summary, SLA breaches, top 5 incidents by duration, (4) Compliance — policy compliance %, top non-compliant policies, (5) Operational hygiene — orphaned resources count and cost, stale RBAC assignments found, alert noise ratio. Format as a structured PDF-ready report with an executive summary, key metrics dashboard table, and per-section details with recommendations."

scenarios.title: KQL log queries (common patterns)
scenarios.source_description: Generates or executes KQL queries for common operational scenarios to speed up log investigations.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Run the following investigation on Log Analytics workspace '{workspace}': show all errors (severity >= 3) in the last 2 hours, grouped by source resource, error code, and count. Include sample error messages for the top 5 patterns."

scenarios.title: Agent health monitoring
scenarios.source_description: Monitors the health of monitoring agents (AMA) to ensure telemetry pipeline continuity.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check all VMs and Arc machines for monitoring agent health. Identify: (1) machines with no heartbeat in the last 15 minutes, (2) agents in 'Not Ready' or 'Error' state, (3) extension provisioning failures. Show machine name, last heartbeat, agent version, and status."

scenarios.title: Diagnostic settings coverage audit
scenarios.source_description: Finds resources that lack diagnostic settings, leaving operational blind spots in monitoring.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Query all resources across subscriptions that support diagnostic settings. Identify those with no diagnostic settings configured, or where settings don't include all available log categories. Group by resource type and show coverage percentage."

scenarios.title: Data collection rules audit
scenarios.source_description: Validates that Data Collection Rules (DCRs) are correctly configured and associated with target resources.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all Data Collection Rules. For each, show: associated resources count, data sources configured, destinations, and transformation status. Flag DCRs with 0 associated resources, DCRs referencing deleted workspaces, or DCRs with no data flowing in the last 24h."

scenarios.title: Resource metrics analysis
scenarios.source_description: Deep-dives into performance metrics for a specific resource during troubleshooting or capacity planning.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Pull the key metrics for resource '{resource_id}' over the last 4 hours with 5-minute granularity. Include CPU, memory, disk IOPS, network in/out, and any resource-specific metrics. Highlight any values exceeding 80% of the resource limit."

scenarios.title: VM performance anomaly detection
scenarios.source_description: Continuously baselines VM performance metrics and alerts when behavior deviates from historical normal.
scenarios.source_prompt: "For all production VMs, compare current 15-minute CPU, memory, disk queue length, and network metrics against the 7-day baseline for the same time window. Flag any VM where current values exceed 2 standard deviations from baseline."

scenarios.title: Resource health status summary
scenarios.source_description: Provides a real-time view of all resource health states to quickly identify degraded infrastructure.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Query Azure Resource Health for all resources in subscriptions. Show summary: count by health status (Available, Degraded, Unavailable, Unknown). List all resources currently in 'Degraded' or 'Unavailable' state with reason and since-when timestamp."

scenarios.title: Alert rules best-practice audit
scenarios.source_description: Evaluates existing alert rules against SRE best practices to find gaps, misconfigurations, or noise generators.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Audit all alert rules across subscriptions. Identify: (1) rules that fired > 20 times in 7 days (noisy), (2) rules in 'Disabled' state, (3) resources without any alert rule, (4) rules without an action group, (5) rules using static thresholds where dynamic would be better."

scenarios.title: Alert fatigue analysis
scenarios.source_description: Identifies noisy, low-value alerts that contribute to alert fatigue and reduce team responsiveness.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Analyze all alert rules that fired in the last 30 days. Identify: (1) alerts that fired > 50 times, (2) alerts that auto-resolved within 5 minutes > 80% of the time, (3) alerts where no action was taken (no comments, no state change). Recommend suppression, threshold adjustment, or consolidation."

scenarios.title: Fired alerts summary (last 24h)
scenarios.source_description: Provides a daily operational summary of all alerts that fired, grouped by severity and resolution status.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all alerts that fired in the last 24 hours across all subscriptions. Group by severity (Sev0-Sev4), show count per severity, average time to resolution, and list unresolved alerts with resource name, alert rule, and time fired."

scenarios.title: Operations dashboard generation
scenarios.source_description: Auto-generates Azure Monitor dashboards for new workloads with standard SRE metrics panels.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Generate an Azure Monitor dashboard JSON for resource group '{rg_name}'. Include panels for: VM CPU/memory/disk, App Service requests/errors/response time, SQL DTU/connections, and a service health tile. Use best-practice layout."

scenarios.title: Workbook auto-generation
scenarios.source_description: Creates ready-to-use Azure Workbooks tailored to a specific workload's monitoring needs.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Generate an Azure Workbook for workload in resource group '{rg_name}'. Auto-detect resource types and include relevant panels: (1) resource health overview, (2) key performance metrics per resource type, (3) error/exception trends, (4) cost trend, (5) recent changes. Export as ARM template for deployment."

scenarios.title: Changes in last 24h for a resource
scenarios.source_description: Shows all configuration changes to a specific resource during incident investigation, helping correlate changes with symptoms.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Show all changes detected by Change Analysis and Activity Log for resource '{resource_id}' in the last 24 hours. For each change, show timestamp, property changed, old value, new value, and who initiated it."

scenarios.title: Changes by non-service-principal users
scenarios.source_description: Identifies manual changes made by human operators that bypassed automation pipelines, a common source of drift and incidents.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Query the Activity Log for the last 24 hours across all subscriptions. Filter for write/delete operations where the caller is NOT a service principal or managed identity. Group by caller, show operation count, resources affected, and timestamps."

scenarios.title: All write operations across subscription (24h)
scenarios.source_description: Provides a daily digest of all infrastructure changes for operational awareness and audit trail.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Summarize all write and delete operations in subscription '{subscription_name}' in the last 24 hours. Group by resource type, show total operations count, and flag any failed operations. Exclude read-only and diagnostic operations."

scenarios.title: Identify who added a firewall/NSG rule
scenarios.source_description: Traces network security rule changes to the specific user and timestamp for security investigation.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Query the Activity Log for operations on NetworkSecurityGroups and AzureFirewall resources in the last 48 hours. For each rule addition or modification, show: timestamp, caller, resource name, rule name, source/destination configured, and ports."

scenarios.title: Rollback command generation for bad changes
scenarios.source_description: Automatically generates revert commands when a problematic change is identified, reducing MTTR.
scenarios.source_prompt: "A problematic change was detected on resource '{resource_id}' at {timestamp}. Based on Change Analysis, identify what was modified. Generate the az CLI or ARM API command to revert the change to its previous value. Include a safety check (--what-if where available)."

scenarios.title: Logic Apps code/definition inspection
scenarios.source_description: Examines the Logic App workflow definition to identify structural issues, deprecated connectors, or error-prone patterns.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Retrieve the workflow definition for Logic App '{logic_app_name}'. Analyze for: (1) actions without error handling (no 'runAfter' failure paths), (2) deprecated connector versions, (3) hardcoded values that should be parameters, (4) loops without concurrency limits, (5) missing retry policies on HTTP actions."

scenarios.title: Support ticket creation (pre-populated)
scenarios.source_description: Generates a pre-filled support ticket with all relevant diagnostic context collected by SRE Agent to accelerate resolution.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Prepare a support ticket for resource '{resource_id}' issue: '{issue_description}'. Collect and include: (1) resource config and SKU, (2) relevant metrics last 4h, (3) related errors in logs, (4) recent changes from Activity Log, (5) Resource Health status. Format as a support request with severity, category, and collected evidence."

scenarios.title: Post-incident review automation
scenarios.source_description: Auto-generates a post-incident review document with timeline, changes, metrics, and impact data.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Incident on resource '{resource_id}' from {start_time} to {end_time} is now resolved. Generate a post-incident review: (1) timeline of events (first alert → detection → response → resolution), (2) changes made during and before incident, (3) metrics during impact window, (4) user/customer impact estimate, (5) action items to prevent recurrence."

scenarios.title: RTO/RPO gap analysis
scenarios.source_description: Validates that disaster recovery configurations meet stated RTO/RPO targets for each critical workload.
scenarios.source_prompt: "For all resources tagged 'Tier=Critical', assess DR posture: (1) is backup configured? frequency vs RPO target, (2) is geo-replication enabled? (3) replication lag vs RPO, (4) is there a failover plan? last DR drill date. Flag workloads where configured RPO > stated RPO target or no DR mechanism exists."

scenarios.title: Backup policy compliance & gap detection
scenarios.source_description: Verifies that all critical resources have backup configured and that backup jobs are completing successfully.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Audit backup coverage: (1) VMs without Azure Backup enabled, (2) SQL databases without backup (PITR or long-term), (3) Cosmos DB accounts without continuous backup, (4) File shares without backup. Also check: failed backup jobs in last 7 days, backup items not backed up in > 24h. Show resource, backup status, last successful backup, and RPO gap."

scenarios.title: SKU reliability assessment
scenarios.source_description: Evaluates resource SKUs against availability requirements, identifying single points of failure or SLA gaps.
scenarios.source_prompt: "For resources in production tagged 'SLA=99.99%', check: (1) VM — is it using Availability Zones or VMSS? (2) SQL — is it Zone-redundant? (3) Storage — is it GRS/GZRS? (4) App Service — is it Premium or in ASE? Flag any resource where SKU SLA is below the stated target."

scenarios.title: Custom Policy generation
scenarios.source_description: Generates Azure Policy definitions for custom compliance requirements that aren't covered by built-in policies.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Generate an Azure Policy definition that: {requirement_description}. Include the policy rule, parameters, effect (audit/deny/modify), and the az CLI command to deploy it at subscription scope. Follow Microsoft naming conventions."

scenarios.title: Find built-in policy for a requirement
scenarios.source_description: Searches Azure's built-in policy catalog to find the best match for a compliance requirement before creating custom.
scenarios.source_prompt: "I need to enforce that: '{requirement}'. Search Azure built-in policies for matching definitions. Show the top 5 matches with: display name, policy ID, effect type, and description. Indicate which one best fits the requirement and whether parameters need customization."

scenarios.title: Policy compliance state monitoring
scenarios.source_description: Tracks compliance state trends and identifies resources falling out of compliance over time.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Show policy compliance summary for subscription '{subscription_name}'. Include: (1) total policies assigned, (2) compliant vs non-compliant resource count, (3) top 10 policies by non-compliance count, (4) resources that became non-compliant in the last 7 days. Show trend vs previous week."

scenarios.title: Effective policies per scope
scenarios.source_description: Shows all policies that actually apply to a specific scope, helping debug policy conflicts and understand cumulative governance.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all effective policies at scope '{scope}' (subscription/RG/resource). Show: policy name, assignment scope (inherited from where), effect, parameters, and exemptions if any. Identify conflicting policies (e.g., one audits and another denies the same condition)."

scenarios.title: Policy exemptions review
scenarios.source_description: Audits policy exemptions to find expired ones and those without proper justification that may be covering non-compliance.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all policy exemptions across subscriptions. Show: exemption name, scope, exempted policy, category (waiver/mitigated), expiration date, and description. Flag: (1) exemptions past their expiration date, (2) exemptions without an expiration date, (3) exemptions with no description/justification."

scenarios.title: Naming & tagging convention compliance
scenarios.source_description: Detects resources that violate organizational naming standards and required tag policies, impacting automation, cost allocation, and operational clarity.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Check all resources against: (1) naming convention regex per resource type: VMs='{vm_pattern}', RGs='{rg_pattern}', Storage='{storage_pattern}'; (2) required tags: 'Environment', 'CostCenter', 'Owner', 'Application'. Show resources not matching patterns and those missing required tags. Prioritize production resources and sort by monthly cost."

scenarios.title: Automated compliance remediation tasks
scenarios.source_description: Triggers Azure Policy remediation tasks for resources that are non-compliant with 'DeployIfNotExists' or 'Modify' policies.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all non-compliant resources under policies with effect 'DeployIfNotExists' or 'Modify' that have a remediation task available. For each policy: (1) count of remediable resources, (2) create a remediation task if none exists or last task is > 7 days old, (3) check status of in-progress remediation tasks. Report: tasks created, in-progress, and completed."

scenarios.title: Azure Policy assignment assessment
scenarios.source_description: Performs a global assessment of all Azure Policy assignments across the management group hierarchy to detect redundancies (same policy assigned at parent and child scope), conflicts (contradictory effects on the same resource type), and shadow assignments (overridden by a higher-scope exemption or a conflicting deny). Provides a clean-sheet view of the effective policy posture.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all Azure Policy assignments across the full management group hierarchy. Analyze for: (1) redundant assignments — same policy definition assigned at both a management group and a child subscription/RG, (2) conflicting assignments — policies with contradictory effects (e.g., one enforces 'deny' on a resource type while another applies 'deployIfNotExists' for the same), (3) orphaned assignments referencing deleted or deprecated policy definitions, (4) assignments with parameters that override or negate the intended effect. For each finding, show policy name, assignment scope, effect, and recommended action (remove, consolidate, or fix). Summarize total assignments, redundancies found, and conflicts detected."

scenarios.title: Failed deployments in last 24h
scenarios.source_description: Surfaces ARM deployment failures with error details to catch broken CI/CD pipelines or misconfigurations early.
scenarios.source_prompt: "List all ARM deployments in 'Failed' state across all subscriptions in the last 24 hours. For each, show: resource group, deployment name, timestamp, error code, error message, and correlation ID. Group by error code to identify patterns."

scenarios.title: Export existing resources to ARM/Bicep
scenarios.source_description: Exports running infrastructure to IaC templates for adopting infrastructure-as-code on existing environments.
scenarios.source_prompt: "Export resource group '{rg_name}' to {Bicep/ARM}. Clean up the export: (1) remove read-only and auto-generated properties, (2) parameterize names, SKUs, and locations, (3) add missing dependencies between resources, (4) organize into modules by resource type. Generate the parameter file with current values."
